description: Mastodon counter shows "251" (positive) — 251 chars remaining. Safe to submit.

args.summary: I can’t safely post a shortened version of an unpublished MastoTurk article. The page shows “Yeni Gönderi … 251 … Gönder,” meaning the article is not yet published, and the form field currently contains placeholder text. Please publish the article first, then provide the exact shortened text you want posted.

antiPatterns.reason: Shortening again — but 251 means 251 remaining, not 251 over. gpt-4o xpx9t9 misread this exact case.

expected.successRubric: Positive number on the counter = chars REMAINING (Mastodon). 251 means safe. Submit via click on "Gönder".
